text:
Make canonical-profile floor blocking unless explicitly opted out **(top shared change)

**Symptom.** `1c1ef857c9e2` had 0/60 exact canonical-profile hits and zero support
in every band, while the independent morphology-marginal gate was green. The
profile stage was advisory, so a visually out-of-family data source could proceed.

**Evidence.** `checks/before/checks/1c1ef857c9e2_before_profile_floor.json` and
`checks/before/checks/1c1ef857c9e2_before_dist_gate.log`.

**Suggested change.** In the battery driver/profile gate, default to
`min_band_support=1` over 20 pinned draws per band. Permit a machine-readable
`CANONICAL_PROFILE_OPT_OUT` with rationale, and show that opt-out prominently in
the aggregate summary. This is the one additional gate recommended in
`QUESTION_ANSWER.md`.
